native_state.authority: unobserved; file-only preparation, no DB access

accepted_reading_history.recorded_at_note: derived9 generation/extraction time is in normalized bundle; not native DB firstsave

before_use: Root supplies actual registered case/issue IDs, current case/config/CAS, source availability/actual firstsave, legitimate packet and current lease. This ticket predicts no queue and creates no case/job.

Read fixed map and explicit upstream file/hash refs; compare actual imported immutable native snapshot SHA before reuse. These six source objects are file intake candidates here, not asserted current DB rows. Do not backdate firstsave to retrieval or reading.
Read actual original case conditions and typed prior_review; do not assume these local K/C/P/I topics are existing native issue IDs or overwrite future case context.

carry_to_both_summary_and_case_observati.reading_time: Preserve saved review timestamps in accepted_reading_history; record this preparation time separately. None is publication/retrieval/DB firstsave.
carry_to_both_summary_and_case_observati.fixed_references: map file/SHA, old followup file/SHA/physical pages, source ID and verified actual native snapshot; source_references above carries candidate native SHAs.
carry_to_both_summary_and_case_observati.known: K1–K9, especially gross-margin versus FY assumption not YoY OP/FX; Indonesia6months/Jan–Mar subsidiary values not parentNI/Emirates; tax method/CF not prepared; completed subsequent sale/Q2 gain within FY guide; QA question versus answer.
carry_to_both_summary_and_case_observati.remaining: P1/P2/C1–C3/I1; unread/currentness, sustainable profit/tax/CF/Emirates/cash-tax remain unknown. No financial adoption or IR readiness.
carry_to_both_summary_and_case_observati.historical_status: Old reviews may record then-unread/awaiting-root; pinned later acceptances and reading chronology resolve progress without rewriting old files. Same-source additional notes are not new publication.

future_contract.pending_only: Exactly each real packet pending ID once. source_reviews and case_observation.evidence_source_ids use pending only. Do not turn old context into pending or substitute its quote for new source quote. If original source is itself pending on actual first intake, review packet snapshot honestly while keeping old publication date.
future_contract.empty_pending: A legitimate due-only empty-pending job has empty source_reviews and evidence_source_ids; old reading context alone cannot supply supports/counterevidence evidence.
future_contract.outcome_management: Determine from actual packet/conditions; no outcome/management date/native version/lease/financial threshold fixed here.
future_contract.prior_projection: prior_review projects summary and case_observation; source_reviews.rationale alone does not retain this handoff.
future_contract.execution: Only authorized current lease owner/root completes; no current job operation or future completion claim here.

limits: No automatic directory scan/packet inclusion; root must manually supply file/hash refs.
No machine guarantee of worker receipt or validation of narrative external file hashes; check actual reading/meaning before completion.
No IR draft/financial branches/price and no new API/config/date manipulation to manufacture jobs.
